name: Leninism
description: A vanguard-led transition to socialism, assessed separately from later Stalinist doctrine and from Lenin’s personal profile.

axes.brief: Working-class councils and recall operate under revolutionary vanguard leadership and exclusion of exploiting classes.
axes.counterEvidence: The stated eventual abolition of the state and participatory councils are counter-evidence to permanent personal dictatorship; universal franchise differs from class-franchise democracy.

axes.brief: Revolutionary defence and public welfare support coercive state measures while workers’ criticism is valued within the revolution.
axes.counterEvidence: Leninist doctrine also calls for expanded working-class participation; general rights for enemies and unrestricted media are not equivalent to intra-party debate.

qualifications.9: Opposition to religious censorship and suppression of counter-revolutionary material compete.

axes.brief: Equality of nations and resistance to national oppression favour plural language and cultural rights.
axes.counterEvidence: A common proletarian culture and unified organisation qualify claims that all distinct cultural demands take priority over shared class purposes.

qualifications.9: Administrative common schedules and cultural equality compete.

axes.brief: Proletarian internationalism and equality across national origins favour worker mobility and refuge.
axes.counterEvidence: Immigration administration is not extensively specified; economic stability and class struggle qualify unrestricted movement under every circumstance.

axes.brief: Anti-imperialist revolution and an armed workers’ state coexist with tactical peace and willingness to defend socialism.
axes.counterEvidence: The anti-war programme is directed against imperialist war, not a prohibition on revolutionary armed conflict.

axes.brief: International proletarian solidarity and voluntary national union favour shared revolutionary commitments.
axes.counterEvidence: Existing bourgeois international institutions are not automatically legitimate; national self-determination remains distinct from obedience to imperial powers.

qualifications.7: Workers’ international goals and national liberation interests can conflict.

axes.brief: Collective control of major production is the objective of transition to socialism.
axes.counterEvidence: The New Economic Policy explicitly allows transitional private commerce and state-capitalist contracts; ultimate doctrine and temporary compromise are distinguished.

axes.brief: External economic exchange is subordinated to development and protection of collective productive control.
axes.counterEvidence: Lenin accepted foreign concessions and commercial incentives during transition; neither complete autarky nor unconditional foreign entry is doctrinally necessary.

qualifications.4: Needed imports and public control of trade compete.
qualifications.16: Communication among workers and control of capitalist providers compete.

axes.brief: National accounting and coordination are central to the socialist transition.
axes.counterEvidence: Temporary market transactions and wage incentives in the NEP qualify an assertion that every price must immediately be fixed.

axes.brief: Abolition of exploitation and broad worker provision favour redistribution and security.
axes.counterEvidence: Transitional differences in wages and property persist; compensated land redistribution is less aligned than revolutionary expropriation.

qualifications.15: Shared distributive aim is qualified by opposition to compensation of exploiting landlords.

axes.brief: Lenin explicitly favours separation of church and state and secular political authority.
axes.counterEvidence: His party’s materialism does not entail compulsory exclusion of every religious worker or criminalisation of all private worship.

axes.brief: Women’s emancipation and transformation of inherited class institutions favour broad social reform.
axes.counterEvidence: Exact modern marriage and identity curricula are not settled by vanguard theory; Leninist traditions have varied in sexual conventions.

qualifications.6: Care for children and emancipation from compulsory family dependence coexist.

axes.brief: Large-scale engineering and productive modernisation are explicit conditions for socialism.
axes.counterEvidence: Materialist science is not evidence of approval for every risky biomedical mechanism; public safety remains a substantive constraint.

axes.brief: Democratic centralism and coordinated economic transition coexist with national self-determination, including secession rights.
axes.counterEvidence: Voluntary union and local participation qualify total central administrative uniformity; the revolutionary centre still directs shared programmes.

axes.brief: Material social conditions, education and class relations explain behaviour more than fixed racial destiny.
axes.counterEvidence: Leninist doctrine does not quantify all individual traits; physiological differences remain compatible with a social account of inequality.

qualifications.12: Individual predisposition and changing social circumstances compete.

sources.title: What is to be done? — revolutionary organisation
Right of nations to self-determination — conclusion

phrase: A society where an organised revolutionary working class controls the state and collective production as a transition toward communism.

religion.reason: Political membership has no religious prerequisite; Lenin’s religion essay requires civil religious freedom alongside a materialist party doctrine.
